body.name: priorityH
body.def: \(\mathfrak P_H\) applies only the four transition relations \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\), in that order, and within a relation chooses the lexicographically least eligible token under \(\operatorname{enc}_H\). No unnamed pruning, district, terminal, or correction rule is part of the schedule.
